item.title: A fun day in Venice
item.description:
- the story of a guitar -

What better place to cure muscle soreness than Venice? It not only has loads of amazing places, streets, corners, shops to explore, but also looots of bridges!

item.title: Book review ~ Neither Here nor There: Travels in Europe
item.description:
Neither Here nor There: Travels in Europe by Bill Bryson

“A breezy and entertaining account of what it is like to be utterly at sea in a continent most of his readers will regard as familiar.” ~ Independent on Sunday
